versions.content: The EthSM shall monitor the requested and current state of the Ethernet Interface Controller . If the EthSM detects a mismatch, it shall bring the hardware back to the corresponding state. (i.e. FullCOM requires the state ETH_MODE_ACTIVE; NoCom requires ETH_MODE_DOWN)
